evidence_quotes.quote: The three villages water pressure falls below the minimum pressure requirements of Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation Number 27/RT/M/2016.

Recommendations for pipeline network restoration involves conducting hydraulic simulation using EPANET 2.2 which identified the need to parallelize existing pipes and establish a new pipe with a diameter of 200 mm and a length of 1960 m

Furthermore, based on the results of the demand pattern measurement, the pump schedule must be modified, as well as the quantity of functioning pumps to be able to meet the water supply demand when the development occurs.

raw_response.plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2: the ministerial regulation is cited solely as a technical minimum-pressure benchmark within a purely hydraulic engineering simulation (EPANET 2.2) of pipe sizing, reservoir capacity, and pump scheduling.
raw_response.rationale: This study is a pure hydraulic engineering analysis of a drinking water distribution network using EPANET 2.2 to determine pipe parallelization, pipe dimensions, reservoir expansion, and pump schedules (E06). Although it references a ministerial regulation for minimum water pressure requirements as a technical benchmark, it does not examine any legal, administrative, regulatory, institutional, or governance mechanism governing household water access.
